title: Contact
description: Contact Yannick Fontan, software developer and independent researcher behind the Symbolic Reasoning Agent (SRA).
deck: Get in touch about SRA, symbolic reasoning, or the games.
name: Yannick Fontan
bio: I build software and explore the foundations of reasoning. My research focuses on making the concepts, goals, and decisions of an intelligent system explicit and understandable.
I’m the creator of SRA (Symbolic Reasoning Agent). Using ARC-AGI-3 and the games in this playground, I investigate how an agent can discover mechanisms, compose reasoning, and reuse knowledge.
invitation: Have a question, an idea, or feedback on the project? I’d be glad to hear from you.
